CommunityApplications.Profile: MCSM (Minecraft Server Manager) is a self-hosted web dashboard that creates and manages Minecraft servers (Vanilla, Paper, Fabric, Forge and modpacks) as Docker containers. This repository provides two templates: mcsm, the dashboard, and infrarust, an optional proxy that routes players to each server by domain on a single port 25565. Worlds and backups are stored as plain folders in appdata. Report problems on the GitHub issue tracker.
